### Company Overview: Jaya Unity Precision Sdn. Bhd.
* **Registration:** SYN-001529 (Active, Private Limited)
* **Location:** Sarawak, Malaysia (Incorporated 1988)
* **Industry:** Precision machining of metal parts for electronics
* **Ownership:** Majority-owned (75.67%) by Managing Director (Director 1)

### Financial & Operational Health (FY2022–FY2024)
* **Revenue Growth:** Grew steadily from RM11.89M (FY2022) to RM16.15M (FY2024).
* **Profitability Turnaround:** Recovered from net losses in FY2022 (-RM1.08M) and FY2023 (-RM333K) to a net profit of RM745K in FY2024.
* **Cash Flow & Liquidity:** Operating cash flow improved significantly to RM1.89M in FY2024. Quick ratio stands at 1.03.
* **Audit & Risk:** Received unqualified audit opinions across all three years. No active litigation recorded.
